verdict.rationale: Replit's docs explicitly document connecting to MCP servers via a curated catalog (Stripe, Linear, Notion, Sentry, etc.) or by adding a custom URL, letting Agent use their tools directly in conversation. This is well-documented first-party evidence but lacks independent hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of MCP usage working reliably, and details on tool-call scoping/permissions.
